## SchemeResourceClient.get() method

Read the scheme identified by `id` within `workspaceName`<!-- -->. When several workspace documents share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used as the workspace document.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get(workspaceName: string, id: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<Scheme>;
```
